# NYU Tandon K12 STEM Education Programs

> NYU Tandon's K12 STEM Education Programs offer inclusive, hands-on summer learning experiences in robotics, AI, cybersecurity, game design, and emerging technologies for middle and high school students.

Based at NYU Tandon School of Engineering in Brooklyn, these programs combine rigorous technical instruction with real-world applications and entrepreneurship opportunities. Many programs offer full scholarships and are designed to increase diversity and access in STEM fields.

## Key Topics

- NYU Tandon School of Engineering
- Summer STEM programs
- Inclusive learning
- High school students
- Robotics
- Artificial Intelligence
- Cybersecurity
- Game design
- Entrepreneurship
- Arduino
- CAD/Makerspace
- Blockchain
- UX Design
- Smart Cities
- Full scholarship opportunities

## Core Programs

- [ARISE](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/arise): ARISE summer research program for high school students at NYU Tandon
- [CACTUS](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/cactus): CACTUS robotics and CAD program for middle school students
- [CE4G](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/ce4g): CE4G Computer Engineering for Good summer program for high school
- [CS4CS](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/cs4cs): CS4CS cybersecurity summer program with CTF competitions
- [Design and Innovation](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/dii): Design and Innovation summer program with CAD and makerspace
- [Game Design and Development](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/GP): Game design and development residential summer program for high school

## AI & Emerging Technologies

- [Machine Learning](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/ml): Machine learning summer program covering neural networks fundamentals
- [IDEA](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/idea): IDEA AI and entrepreneurship summer program for public service innovation
- [Cryptocurrency & Blockchain](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/cr): Cryptocurrency residential summer program in blockchain and cryptography
- [XR Augmented Reality](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/xr): XR augmented reality summer program with SparkAR and Aero

## Robotics & Engineering

- [mBODY](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/mbody): mBODY humanoid robotics program with computer vision and AI
- [SONYC](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/sonyc): SONYC sound engineering program addressing NYC noise pollution
- [Science of Smart Cities](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/sosc): Science of Smart Cities program with electronics and coding projects

## Design & Entrepreneurship

- [UX Design](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/ux): UX design summer program using Figma and Adobe Creative Suite
- [ieSoSC](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu/programs/iesosc): ieSoSC smart cities entrepreneurship program with full scholarship

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://k12stem.engineering.nyu.edu): NYU Tandon K12 STEM Education homepage showcasing inclusive programs
